preconditions.description: The number of gnomes N must be between 1 and 500.
The number of queries M must be between 1 and 500.
The time k for each query must be between 0 and 10^9.
The gnome id x for each query must be between 1 and N.

preconditions.expression: all(all(g[i][j] in {0, 1} for j in range(N)) for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: The friendship matrix g must contain only 0s and 1s.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(len(gnomes)) + '\n' + ' '.join(map(str, sorted(gnomes))) if gnomes else '-1'
postconditions.description: The output must contain the count of gnomes who know the joke after k minutes, followed by their ids in increasing order, or -1 if none.
If k is 0, no gnomes will know the joke, resulting in an empty list.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= gnome_id <= N for gnome_id in gnomes)
postconditions.description: All gnome ids in the output must be valid and within the range from 1 to N.
